parameters.query:
SELECT 
    e.id AS event_id, 
    p.cleanmessage, 
    p.loglevel, 
    e.log_date, 
    e.server_name, 
    e.count, 
    p.answer, 
    e.times 
FROM public.log_events e 
JOIN public.log_patterns p ON e.pattern_id = p.id 
WHERE e.log_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 days' 
ORDER BY e.log_date DESC, e.count DESC;
